ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, point $C$ is the midpoint of segment $BD$, $AD=3\,\text{cm}$, $AC=7\,\text{cm}$. What is the length of $AB$ in centimeters?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given that $AD=3\,cm$ and $AC=7\,cm$,

thus, $CD=AC-AD=4\,cm$,

since point $C$ is the midpoint of line segment $BD$,

it follows that $BC=CD=4\,cm$,

therefore, $AB=AC+BC=7\,cm+4\,cm=\boxed{11\,cm}$.
